message.reasoning_content:
用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，按照 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开问答样本（关于下背痛和高血压的关联）构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。

核心目标：通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C）。
必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
2. 保留 raw_evidence，生成 stored memory（第三人称、总结式、去口语化）。
3. memory_blocks 语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 拆分 atomic memories，用于打标签和评估。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory text 必须是第三人称，evidence 保留 raw evidence。
7. 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. 只允许补充 hard A（看似相关但无决策权）。
10. hard A 必须属于指定 family。
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 至少 1 个 B/C，否则 accepted=false。

分析原始样本：
raw_question: What causes lower back pain long after treating back injury? Hello, My name is Troy,,Seven years ago I had what was called a slip fall accident, twisting of the lower back. I had to distinguish my lower back Pain. Having follow up care with practicing physician. It would seem other than my pain of the lower back, high-blood pressure. I never had in any of past visits before..could there be a link?
doctor_answer: Hi Mr Troy,I have gone through your question in detail and understand your concern.Yes,there could be a link between the two.You may be suffering from a lumbar disc prolapse causing nerve root compression.The trigger may have been the 7 years old trauma.I would suggest you to get a MRI of the lumbar spine done to rule out a disc prolapse and consult a orthopedist / neurosurgeon.I hope the answer was useful to you.Get back to me for any doubts that you may have.Best wishes.

当前任务（去背景化 question）：
What causes lower back pain long after treating a back injury, and could there be a link between chronic lower back pain and newly developed high blood pressure?

提取证据与记忆：
1. 7年前有滑倒事故，扭伤下背部（slip fall accident, twisting of the lower back 7 years ago）。
2. 目前有下背痛（chronic lower back pain）。
3. 新发现高血压（newly developed high blood pressure, never had in past visits）。
4. 正在接受执业医生的随访护理（Having follow up care with practicing physician）。

分析记忆类型与 ABC 标签：
- 7年前下背部扭伤史：C（Answer-Controlling）。这是解释当前下背痛和高血压关联的核心病因线索（医生提到 trauma 可能是 trigger，导致 lumbar disc prolapse）。如果不知道这个创伤史，就无法给出具体的病理机制推测。
- 新发高血压：C（Answer-Controlling）。这是问题的核心之一，探讨下背痛与高血压的关联。
- 正在接受执业医生的随访护理：B（Bounded Footprint）。这影响建议的下一步行动（例如建议他与当前医生沟通，或者在建议做 MRI 时考虑到他已有随访医生）。
- 补充 Hard A：
  - 患者名字叫 Troy (profile_style_near_neighbor / untriggered_preference)。在通用医疗问答中，名字不需要在回答中体现，过度使用会导致过度个性化（"Hello Troy"），在 benchmark 中通常视为 A（No Footprint），除非系统设定必须称呼。这里设为 A。
  - 患者过去没有高血压（fact_judgment_pollution）。"I never had in any of past visits before" -> 过去没有高血压是事实，但当前任务是解释“新发高血压与下背痛的关联”，过去没有高血压只是确认了“新发”这个事实，不需要在答案中反复强调“因为你以前没有”，过度强调可能偏离医学解释。或者，构造一个关于“患者偏好保守治疗”的 hard A（untriggered_preference），但原文没提。
  - 让我们用“患者名字叫 Troy”作为 profile_style_near_neighbor 的 hard A。或者用“患者过去就诊记录中没有高血压”作为 fact_judgment_pollution（看似相关，因为提到了 past visits，但实际上当前只需关注“新发”这一现状，过度纠结过去记录可能干扰对当前病理机制的分析）。
  - 更好的 Hard A: "患者七年前事故后曾接受过物理治疗" (synthetic, evidence_conflict / scope_overreach) - 原文没提。
  - 还是用原文的：患者提到 "I had to distinguish my lower back Pain" (可能是指区分疼痛，或者打字错误)。
  - 让我们构造一个基于原文的 Hard A: "患者在过去就诊中从未有过高血压记录" (fact_judgment_pollution)。看似相关（证明是新发），但没有决策权（医生只需要知道现在是新发高血压，不需要在回答中分析他过去的就诊记录）。
  - 另一个 Hard A: "患者希望了解高血压是否由下背痛直接引起" (scope_overreach)。原文是 "could there be a link"，如果记忆存为“患者认为高血压是下背痛直接引起的”，这是过度推断。
  - 采用 "患者名字叫 Troy" (profile_style_near_neighbor)。在医疗问答中，称呼名字通常是 B 或 A。如果设为 A，过度使用就是 "Hello Troy"。
  - 采用 "患者七年前事故后一直有下背痛" (这是 C)。
  - 让我们构造一个 "患者对疼痛的耐受度较高" (untriggered_preference) - 纯合成，不行，要求 hard A 必须看似相关。
  - 原文："I had to distinguish my lower back Pain." 可能是 "distinguish" 拼写错误，意为 "extinguish" 或 "distinguish from other pain"。
  - 让我们用 "患者目前由执业医生进行随访" (B)。
  - Hard A 1: 患者名为 Troy (profile_style_near_neighbor)。看似相关（个人信息），但在纯医学机制解释中无决策权，过度使用会导致不必要的寒暄。
  - Hard A 2: 患者过去就诊从未有高血压记录 (fact_judgment_pollution)。看似相关（强调新发），但当前任务只需基于“新发高血压”这一事实进行医学解释，过度使用会导致回答中冗余讨论“过去的就诊记录”，偏离病理机制分析。

梳理 Memory Blocks:
Block 1: 创伤史与当前症状
- raw_evidence: "Seven years ago I had what was called a slip fall accident, twisting of the lower back... other than my pain of the lower back"
- memory_text: 患者七年前因滑倒事故导致下背部扭伤，目前患有慢性下背痛。
- u_star: C

Block 2: 新发高血压与既往史
- raw_evidence: "high-blood pressure. I never had in any of past visits before..could there be a link?"
- memory_text: 患者新近发现高血压，既往就诊记录中无高血压病史，询问其与下背痛的关联。
- u_star: C (新发高血压是C，既往无记录是A) -> 拆分原子记忆。

Block 3: 随访状态与个人信息
- raw_evidence: "Hello, My name is Troy... Having follow up care with practicing physician."
- memory_text: 患者名为Troy，目前正在接受执业医生的随访护理。
- u_star: B (随访状态), A (名字)

拆分 Atomic Memories:
p1_a1: 患者七年前因滑倒事故导致下背部扭伤。(C) - 创伤史是解释神经根压迫和椎间盘突出的关键触发因素。
p1_a2: 患者目前患有慢性下背痛。(C) - 当前核心症状。
p2_a1: 患者新近发现高血压。(C) - 核心症状，需要解释与下背痛的关联（如疼痛引起的交感神经兴奋，或药物副作用等，医生回答中提到了 link）。
p2_a2: 患者既往就诊记录中无高血压病史。(A - fact_judgment_pollution) - 看似相关（证明新发），但无决策权，过度使用会导致冗余讨论过去记录。
p3_a1: 患者目前正在接受执业医生的随访护理。(B) - 影响下一步建议（如建议与当前随访医生沟通进行MRI检查）。
p3_a2: 患者名为Troy。(A - profile_style_near_neighbor) - 个人信息，在医学机制解释中无决策权，过度使用导致不必要的寒暄。

检查 ABC 分布：
C: p1_a1, p1_a2, p2_a1 (3个)
B: p3_a1 (1个)
A: p2_a2, p3_a2 (2个)
总共 6 个原子记忆。符合 3-6 个 memory block 的要求（这里 3 个 block，6 个 atom）。

细化每个 atom 的 label_reason 和 usage_rubric：

p1_a1 (C): 七年前下背部扭伤史。
- controlling_factor: 创伤史是推测腰椎间盘突出和神经根压迫的核心病因线索。
- missing_memory_failure: 忽略此记忆会导致无法将当前症状与既往创伤联系起来，给出泛泛的下背痛原因，而非针对性的创伤后遗症分析。

p1_a2 (C): 慢性下背痛。
- controlling_factor: 下背痛是问题的核心症状之一，必须作为分析的基础。
- missing_memory_failure: 忽略会导致回答偏离下背痛这一主题。

p2_a1 (C): 新发高血压。
- controlling_factor: 高血压是问题的另一核心，必须解释其与下背痛的潜在病理生理联系（如疼痛应激、药物影响等）。
- missing_memory_failure: 忽略会导致无法回答用户关于“两者是否有关联”的核心疑问。

p2_a2 (A): 既往无高血压记录。
- contamination_signals: 影响结论（过度强调过去记录而忽视当前病理机制），改变排序（把重点放在证明“新发”上）。
- failure_direction: 过度使用会导致回答中冗余讨论“因为你以前没有，所以现在是新发”，偏离医学解释。

p3_a1 (B): 接受执业医生随访。
- allowed_memory_use: 在建议进一步检查（如MRI）或专科就诊时，建议患者与当前的随访医生沟通或协调。
- maximum_footprint: 仅在行动建议部分轻微提及，不改变医学机制解释的主干。

p3_a2 (A): 患者名为Troy。
- contamination_signals: 污染证据权重（将注意力转移到个性化寒暄上）。
- failure_direction: 过度使用会导致回答以 "Hello Troy" 开头，在严格的医学问答 benchmark 中被视为 overpersonalization。

检查 JSON 格式和字段要求：
- accepted: true
- question: 去背景化后的问题。
"What causes lower back pain long after treating a back injury, and could there be a link between chronic lower back pain and newly developed high blood pressure?"
- memory_blocks: 3 个 block。
- memories: 6 个 atom。
- 每个 A 包含 contamination_signals。

用户希望我作为一个多领域适度个性化 benchmark 的数据构造 agent，根据 CRK-2 方案，将一条公开的医疗问答样本构造成 memory-use / over-use benchmark 记录。
核心目标是通用对话中的记忆使用强度校准（A/B/C 分类）。

输入样本：
raw_question: I often feel very lethargic and unmotivated. I try to study but my mind feels constantly blank and all I have enough attention span for is laying in bed with the tv on. Ive tried changing my environment and drinking coffee to wake me up but I just dont feel well. I feel lethargic enough to just lay in bed and watch the ceiling fan spin all day, even though I have so much to do. Whats going on with me?
doctor_answer: Hello, welcome to Chat Doctor. Lack of interest in subject may be the reason of your problem. It will be better to structure your routine. Following steps will help you

任务分析：
1. 去背景化 question：移除个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。
原问题描述了症状： lethargic, unmotivated, mind blank, lack of attention span, laying in bed, tried changing environment and coffee, watch ceiling fan spin.
去背景化后的 question 应该是询问这些症状可能的原因或建议。例如："What could be causing severe lethargy, lack of motivation, blank mind, and inability to focus on studying despite trying environmental changes and caffeine?"

2. 提取 raw_evidence 并生成 stored memory (memory_blocks)。
原问题中的背景/事实：
- 经常感到极度嗜睡/乏力 (lethargic) 和缺乏动力 (unmotivated)。
- 尝试学习时大脑空白 (mind feels constantly blank)。
- 注意力只能集中在躺在床上看电视 (laying in bed with the tv on)。
- 尝试过改变环境和喝咖啡，但感觉不好 (tried changing environment and drinking coffee... just dont feel well)。
- 甚至能躺一天看吊扇转 (watch the ceiling fan spin all day)，尽管有很多事要做。

医生回答：
- 缺乏兴趣可能是原因 (Lack of interest in subject)。
- 建议规划日常 (structure your routine)。

3. 拆分 atomic memories 并打标签 (A/B/C)。
当前任务是解答“我怎么了？”（症状评估/鉴别诊断）。
对于症状评估，患者描述的症状本身就是当前任务的核心输入，不应该作为“历史记忆”来影响当前任务，或者说，如果这些症状是作为“记忆”存储的，它们在当前询问“我怎么了”时，实际上是当前问题的上下文。
等等，CRK-2 方案中，如果原始问题是询问当前症状，那么症状本身是 question 的一部分。如果把它们变成 memory，那 question 就变成 "What's going on with me?"，而症状变成 memory。
但规则 1 说：“先写去背景化 question。question 保留当前任务，但移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。”
如果症状是当前的 acute complaint，它们应该留在 question 里，还是进入 memory？
通常，长期存在的状态（如“我经常感到乏力”）可以作为 profile_fact 或 case_fact 进入 memory。
让我们把“经常感到极度嗜睡和缺乏动力，尝试学习时大脑空白，注意力涣散”作为 memory。
去背景化 question: "What are the potential medical or psychological causes for experiencing chronic lethargy, lack of motivation, cognitive blankness, and severe attention deficits that do not respond to caffeine or environmental changes?" （或者更简单点："What could be causing chronic lethargy, lack of motivation, and inability to focus?")

My hips, knees and ankles ache.

As the spine releases called as the spinal nerve roots which when trapped leads to such symptoms. Also, the nerve as dual functions of sensory and motor too. Any mild compression on the nerve will lead to any of the symptoms like motor weakness or some sensory issues like pain which can be continuous in nature. Usually with physical therapy and proper vitamins supplement the symptoms can be reduced. As in my clinical practice we recommend a combination of Chat Doctor. user_defined_params.raw_question: Done MRI scan. Can online doctor help? Received copy of MRI scan of my brain without contrast. It states areas of FLAIR signal identified in the left, frontal and temporal lobes do not enhance. What does this mean? The impression states no enhancing lesions are identified with brain parenchyma. The differential for non enhancing lesions include gliosis from inflammation or ischemia (chronic) versus a demyelinating process. What does this mean? Is it serious? mS?
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Hi,Your MRI brain shows hyperintensity in flair sequences involving L) frontal and temporal lobe.Lesion is not enhancing with contrast indicates the lesion is not activeDifferential include gliosis from inflammation or ischemia (chronic) versus a demyelinating process.Gliosis is a nonspecific reactive change of glial cells in response to damage to the central nervous system (CNS). In most cases, gliosis involves the proliferation or hypertrophy of several different types of glial cells, including astrocytes, microglia, and oligodendrocytes. In its most extreme form, the proliferation associated with gliosis leads to the formation of a glial scar.Gliosis can occur either due to inflammation of brain secondary to infection or trauma and it can also occur following decrease blood supply to brainOther differential is demyelination .Regarding the possibillity of MS depends on the history and clinical examination and comparison with serials of MRI done previously and other tests like VEP , CSF oligoclonal band.You should consult Neurologist for further plan of actionRegardsDr Sandhya ManorenjNeurologistHi Tech city Hyderabad

user_defined_params.raw_question: I have been suffering for the last 2 weeks with pain in my back. Thought first that I pulled a muscle, but 9 days ago ended up in hospital with excruciating pain. I was put on a drip, given a blood test, a urine test, ct scan and later i was told that I probably passed a kidney stone . had a bit of blood in the urine, no infection, no stone. 9 days later the pain is still there. Went back to Dr 4 days ago who said to wait a few days more. I sleep well, morning are ok as long as I rest but pain gradually comes back later in the day to almost unbearable. I take paracetamol and ibuprofen , drink loads of water but it doesn t seem to do much good. I have been referred to a Urologist , don t know how long that will take. I need to be able to work and I m now worried, but mainly because I do not know what causes this pain. Cld you pls help me
user_defined_params.doctor_answer: Dear FLP. Pickersgill, hello. The back pain was due to kidney stone. It is also the cause of blood seen in your urine (Hematuria). It is possible that full stone has not passed out or some particles of the stone were not cleared, resulting in deposit of more particles and formation of stone again. This may be the cause of pain repeating. You can have Ultrasound and X-Ray PUB region to confirm the diagnosis. Also have a Urine investigation done for Routine and Microscopic examination to check whether some infection has been developed due to the stone. Hope this is useful to you. Thanks.

必须遵守的规则：
1. 去背景化 question：保留当前任务，移除将进入 memory 的个人背景、历史事实、约束和偏好。

3. memory_blocks 表示未拆分前的 stored memory block。语义连贯，包含 raw_evidence 和 memory_text。
4. 把每条 memory_text 拆成 atomic memories。
5. 原子记忆拆分原则：独立判断、独立使用。
6. atomic memory 的 text 必须是第三人称 stored memory，evidence 保留对应 raw evidence。
7. 对每个 atom 独立标 A/B/C，生成 judge-facing usage_rubric。
8. B/C 主要来自原始 raw_question 或 doctor_answer。
9. 只允许补充 hard A。hard A 必须看似相关但当前无决策权。
10. hard A 必须属于指定 family 之一。
11. 每条 hard A 必须写 construction_target。
12. 至少 1 个 B/C 原子记忆，否则 accepted=false。

- A = No Footprint
- B = Bounded Footprint
- C = Answer-Controlling

It would have been great had I examined you on my own. I would suggest you - not panic-avoid oily, spicy food-take a soft, bland diet - get a full liver function test done-also get an abdominal ultrasound done. I would also suggest you to visit a clinician. He/she can examine you and correlate clinically. Hope this answers your question. If you have additional questions or follow-up questions then please do not hesitate in writing to us. I will be happy to answer your questions. Wishing you good health.
